name: web_fetch
description: Fetch web content from approved knowledge sources. Pass a full URL to direct-fetch a page; pass a topic/question to search the curated source catalog (config/web_sources.yaml). Primary docs, lab publications, and peer-reviewed references are prioritized over community sources; Wikipedia is consulted but kept in the defer tier.
summary: Search the curated knowledge catalog or fetch a URL directly.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query, topic, or full URL to direct-fetch. URLs MUST be http:// or https:// — file/data/javascript/etc. schemes are rejected.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return after de-duplication. Capped by `max_results_ceiling` constraint.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Optional dewey category hint (e.g. 'science', 'python') the substrate already knows for this goal. Routes credible_sources deterministically instead of guessing from query keywords; the wiki search still uses the precise subdomain in `query`. Omit for free-text/URL queries.

query.description: Original search query, topic, or direct-fetch URL.

results.description: Fetched content blobs after URL de-duplication.

credible_sources.description: Curated source hints for the detected domain, from config/web_sources.yaml.

domain.description: Detected config/web_sources.yaml domain key, or empty for URL/no-match queries.

total_results.description: Count of de-duplicated fetched results BEFORE max_results truncation.

error.description: Empty string on success; error message when the fetch failed entirely (no results returned).
